findings.source_en: Look at the young general. Spin around. Look at the young general. Spin around. The next time you look to young general, it will change your surrounds.
findings.ar: انظر إلى الجنرال الشاب. دُر. انظر إلى الجنرال الشاب. دُر. وحين تنظر إليه مجددًا، ستتبدل من حولك الجهات.
findings.issue: Same defect as its near-duplicate /12D107064597AE2AF4FE27920DA47415 (chunk 77): 'your surrounds' is the surroundings — the room itself changes. الجهات means the compass directions, turning the riddle's payoff into disorientation. Fix both together, since the two rows are the same puzzle hint.
findings.suggested_ar: انظر إلى الجنرال الشاب. دُر. انظر إلى الجنرال الشاب. دُر. وحين تنظر إليه مجددًا، يتبدّل ما حولك.

findings.issue: An actuator is the part that drives a mechanism, not an engine. محرّك is a motor, which overstates the item — it is one of the four key items handed to Franz to unlock a Tarforge function, not a power source.

This is an unfilled authoring placeholder that shipped in the string table, and 'flavour text' has been translated word-for-word: نكهة is the taste of food, so the string reads 'the taste-text of the map station'. If it stays translated it needs the editorial sense (نص وصفي); the safer option is to leave it byte-identical to the English like the other dev markers.

findings.source_en: My love, do not worry. We’ve finally picked up the Grisha’s tracks again. I left the key by our hut. It's in the usual spot.
findings.ar: يا حبيبتي، لا تقلقي. عثرنا أخيرًا على أثر الغريشا من جديد. تركت المفتاح قرب كوخنا، في المكان المعتاد.
findings.issue: The Arabic commits to a FEMALE addressee (حبيبتي، تقلقي) on a note whose English marks no gender at all. Nothing in the surrounding hunter notes in batches 44-45 establishes who the letter is to. Flagging as an unverified commitment rather than a confirmed error: if the recipient is checked in-game and is male, both forms are wrong; if unverifiable, a gender-neutral opening avoids the guess.
findings.suggested_ar: يا حبيبي، لا تقلق. عثرنا أخيرًا على أثر الغريشا من جديد. تركت المفتاح قرب كوخنا، في المكان المعتاد.

findings.issue: CORRECTION to my earlier reading of this row. The glossary now rules Marigold = ماريغولد, an NPC name in ST_Core_NpcNames alongside Basil/Daisy/Holly (all transliterated), explicitly 'NOT the plant الآذريون'. The current Arabic translates a person's name into a flower.
Frozen glossary term: Cultist = عابد الطائفة, explicitly NOT تابع الطائفة, because التابِع is frozen as Harros's Vassal title.
Frozen glossary transliteration: Mutton = ماتون (Vlas's caged companion). موتن is a second spelling of the same name.
Duplicate of the row above; must move with it.
